sleep_driver_pattern: N/A (waking goal-pipeline onboarding scheduler; no sleep loop)

config.rails: symmetric (enter/exit per-mode thresholds cleared) on every eval cell, as 935a

stage_plan.name: nursery_forced_feed
stage_plan.desc: forced supra-threshold benefit; z_goal formation decoupled from survival

stage_plan.name: guided_low_conflict
stage_plan.desc: reef-refuge spawn, hfa=0, goal pipeline frozen; encoder/E2/E3 warm-up

stage_plan.name: easy_foraging
stage_plan.desc: goal pipeline unfrozen, low hazard; ecological contact begins

stage_plan.name: mature_test
stage_plan.desc: frozen-policy measurement under guarded hfa; substrate gate evaluated

interpretation.label: substrate_not_ready_requeue
interpretation.combination_rule: PASS iff C1_reversals_survive_training_with_drive (single load-bearing criterion). C2_drive_off_stays_one_way is a STRUCTURAL CONTROL (load_bearing False): it is informative only when off_return_reachable (the OFF arm's argmax ever returned to external_task while the register was away); otherwise it is arithmetic and criteria_non_degenerate marks it false. C3_shared_upstream is a separate hypothesis (H-SHARED), not in the PASS gate, routing its own label.

preconditions.name: foraging_contact_guard
preconditions.description: 935a's P2 contact guard (contact_rate > 0 AND z_goal_norm_at_contact_peak > 0.4) on >= 2/3 seeds; an agent that never became foraging-competent has no active goal and the goal-gated drive cannot engage.
preconditions.control: cleared 5/5 by V3-EXQ-935a on this curriculum (seeds 47-51).

preconditions.name: drive_engages_on_arm
preconditions.description: mean external_task_drive input in ARM_DRIVE_ON final eval > floor on >= 2/3 guard seeds. C1 routes on ON-arm reversals, which need the drive input live; a zero drive starves C1 rather than falsifying it.
preconditions.control: 935a ARM cells at the same config: external_task margins 0.32-0.81 on 5/5 seeds.

preconditions.name: dacc_salience_live
preconditions.description: mean dacc_pe in ARM_DRIVE_OFF final eval > floor on >= 2/3 guard seeds. The dACC alarm is the only default salience source; without it neither arm can switch (the dACC-off wiring failure), which is not the question here.
preconditions.control: untrained modetrace A1: dacc_pe 0.19-1.27 on 3/3 seeds.

criteria.name: C2_drive_off_stays_one_way
criteria.role: structural control; informative only if off_return_reachable
criteria.per_seed_statistic: ARM_DRIVE_OFF n_into_external <= 1 AND n_out_of_external >= 0.5 x lives

criteria.name: C3_shared_upstream
criteria.per_seed_statistic: corr(dacc_pe, ||z_harm_a||_2) >= 0.8 AND dacc_pe and ||z_harm_a||_2 mean growth init->final >= 3.0x

dv_symmetry.dv: register switch sequence (argmax(operating_mode) changes gated by salience_aggregate > threshold)
dv_symmetry.ARM_DRIVE_OFF_vs_ON: NOT INVARIANT: removes a signed external_task-only logit term and a salience term -- changes logit differences, not a common offset; untrained D2 moved 0/0/0 -> 2/16/25.

interpretation.premise_corrected: 935a's config already had use_external_task_drive=True; the new arm is the drive-OFF lesion of the same trained weights.
